name: Blockquote Continuity Fix
description: Repairs blockquote depth lost when Digital Garden expands Dataview, note transclusions, and Base embeds.
author: Ben Forde

settings.name: Enable by default
settings.description: Apply the repair to candidate notes unless dg-bq-fix is explicitly false. Leave off to opt in note-by-note with dg-bq-fix: true.
